content_sections.text: Candidates who wish to apply for ICAR IARI Various Posts Recruitment 2026 via email should follow the steps below. Read the official notification carefully before applying. Prepare your application with complete bio-data including personal details, educational qualifications, and experience. Attach self-attested copies of all required documents such as educational certificates, experience certificates, ID proof, and recent passport-size photographs. Clearly mention the post applied for in the subject line of the email. Send the complete application to the official email address mentioned in the notification. Ensure the email is sent before the last date: 09-09-2026. Keep a copy of the sent email for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the Guest Faculty posts at ICAR IARI?
faq.answer: The last date to submit your application via email for the Guest Faculty positions at ICAR IARI is September 9, 2026. Ensure your application reaches before this deadline.

faq.question: Q2. What is the educational qualification required for the Guest Faculty positions?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess a Master’s Degree with at least 55% marks, along with NET/SET/SLET qualification or a Ph.D. degree, as per UGC/ICAR guidelines.

faq.question: Q3. What is the age limit for applying to these Guest Faculty roles?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for applying to the Guest Faculty positions is 70 years. There are no specified minimum age limits mentioned in the provided data.

faq.question: Q4. How will the candidates be selected for the Guest Faculty positions?
faq.answer: The selection process for the Guest Faculty positions at ICAR IARI will be based on a Walk-in Interview. Candidates are advised to prepare accordingly.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary offered for the Guest Faculty positions?
faq.answer: The salary for the Guest Faculty positions is Rs. 1500/- per lecture, with a maximum monthly earning of Rs. 50,000/-.

faq.question: Q6. Is there any application fee for the ICAR IARI Guest Faculty recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for this recruitment drive.

faq.question: Q7. What are the specific posts available under this recruitment?
faq.answer: The available posts are Guest Faculty (Textile Science and Garment/Apparel Design) and Guest Faculty (Human Development and Counselling).

faq.question: Q8. What is the total number of vacancies for the Guest Faculty posts?
faq.answer: There are a total of 2 vacancies announced for the Guest Faculty positions at ICAR IARI.

faq.question: Q9. Where will the Walk-in Interview be conducted?
faq.answer: The Walk-in Interview will be conducted at ICAR Indian Agricultural Research Institute, New Delhi, Pincode: 110012.

faq.question: Q10. How should candidates apply for these positions?
faq.answer: Candidates need to apply via email by sending their complete application along with required documents to the official email address provided in the notification.
